title: KalKat driveway gate
description: Explore your custom double-swing driveway gate. Compare the two rail layouts and let us know what you would like to change before we prepare your quote.
note: 26 ft closed span with a 1/2 in center gap. Each leaf is 12 ft 11 3/4 in wide. Manual operation. Dimensions and final construction details will be confirmed before fabrication.
